zz_md_swap_merchant_company_kernel = {
    if = {
        limit = { zz_md_pair_valid = yes scope:zz_md_a = { is_domicile_type = merchant_company } }
        scope:actor = { set_variable = { name = zz_md_swap_busy value = yes } set_variable = { name = zz_swap_incomplete value = yes } }
        scope:zz_md_a = { zz_md_company_apply_snapshot = { SOURCE = zz_md_company_b } }
        scope:zz_md_b = { zz_md_company_apply_snapshot = { SOURCE = zz_md_company_a } }
        if = {
            limit = { zz_md_company_pair_matches = { LEFT = zz_md_company_b RIGHT = zz_md_company_a } zz_md_pair_same_main = yes scope:zz_md_a = { zz_md_company_main_rank = scope:actor.var:zz_md_core_target_rank } }
            scope:actor = { remove_variable = zz_md_swap_busy remove_variable = zz_swap_incomplete set_variable = { name = zz_md_swap_completed value = yes } trigger_event = zz_md.0201 }
        }
        else = {
            scope:zz_md_a = { zz_md_company_apply_snapshot = { SOURCE = zz_md_company_a } }
            scope:zz_md_b = { zz_md_company_apply_snapshot = { SOURCE = zz_md_company_b } }
            scope:zz_md_a = { if = { limit = { NOT = { zz_md_company_attachments_match = { SOURCE = zz_md_company_a } } } zz_md_company_keep_recovery = { SOURCE = zz_md_company_a } } }
            scope:zz_md_b = { if = { limit = { NOT = { zz_md_company_attachments_match = { SOURCE = zz_md_company_b } } } zz_md_company_keep_recovery = { SOURCE = zz_md_company_b } } }
            scope:actor = {
                remove_variable = zz_md_swap_busy
                if = { limit = { zz_md_company_pair_matches = { LEFT = zz_md_company_a RIGHT = zz_md_company_b } } remove_variable = zz_swap_incomplete }
                zz_md_report_attachment_failure = yes
            }
        }
    }
    else = { scope:actor = { trigger_event = zz_md.0202 } }
}

zz_md_company_liquidate_effect = {
    zz_md_company_refund_internal_effect = yes
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { zz_md_company_paid_internal_remains = yes } }
        zz_md_company_refund_external_effect = yes
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { zz_md_company_paid_external_remains = yes } }
            zz_md_company_refund_main_effect = yes
        }
    }
}
